relationships.subject: HM10
relationships.evidence_quote: HM10, carrying the Michael acceptor group in the ester side chain, produced almost complete inhibition (>95%) on Cav3.2

relationships.subject: HM8
relationships.evidence_quote: HM8 and MD20 were selective blockers of the T-type calcium channel (Cav3.2)

key_findings: Pluronic F-127/F-108 micelles with alpha-tocopherol in gel greatly improve photostability of T-type blocking DHPs HM10 and MD20.
Cav3.2 blockade by DHPs is proposed as topical neuropathic pain therapy; analgesic effects of the gels not yet tested.
